description_en: Queries the domains of a user ranked by traffic volume by calling DescribeLiveTopDomainsByFlow
description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveTopDomainsByFlow获取用户按流量排名的域名
name: DescribeLiveTopDomainsByFlow

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. If you do not specify this parameter, data for the current month is returned by default.
parameters.description_zh:
获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。最小数据粒度为5分钟，不写默认读取当月数据。
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. If you do not specify this parameter, data for the current month is returned by default

parameters.description_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.description_zh:
结束时间需大于起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。
